tools.description: Recommended MCP tool for agentic clients. Provide one `.tif` or `.tiff` 3D volume as a Gradio File input. Public `http`/`https` TIFF URLs can be passed directly; local user files should be uploaded with the Gradio `upload_file_to_gradio` helper when the MCP client provides it. The expected array layout is `(Z, Y, X)`. The tool returns a downloadable zlib-compressed uint8 TIFF mask plus JSON metadata. Mask labels are 0 = background and 1 = lung tissue. This tool is intended for research workflows and is not for clinical diagnosis without expert validation.

type.title: FileData
type.additional_description:
The FileData class is a subclass of the GradioModel class that represents a file object within a Gradio interface. It is used to store file data and metadata when a file is uploaded.

Attributes:
    path: The server file path where the file is stored.
    url: The normalized server URL pointing to the file.
    size: The size of the file in bytes.
    orig_name: The original filename before upload.
    mime_type: The MIME type of the file.
    is_stream: Indicates whether the file is a stream.
    meta: Additional metadata used internally (should not be changed).

/analyze.description: Same input as `process` (a 2D nuclei image). Return the detection report as JSON: engine, model, number of objects, mean area, detection F1 (IoU-matched vs the baked ground-truth labels), and per-object star-convex polygon summaries.

tools.description: Input: a single camera-trap IMAGE (PNG/JPG/TIFF/BMP/WEBP) OR a VIDEO (MP4/MOV/AVI/MKV/WEBM), colour or grayscale/IR. Detect wildlife (Pyrenees mammals) and return a summary image (the annotated frame, or a montage of sampled annotated frames for video). Routes by colorspace (grey→BW, colour→COLOR) like PyrVision. engine: 'fast' (saliency) or 'pyrvision' (real YOLO); conf<0 = auto (0.6 BW / 0.8 COLOR); max_frames samples a video.

/process.description: Input: a single camera-trap IMAGE (PNG/JPG/TIFF/BMP/WEBP) OR a VIDEO (MP4/MOV/AVI/MKV/WEBM), colour or grayscale/IR. Detect wildlife (Pyrenees mammals) and return a summary image (the annotated frame, or a montage of sampled annotated frames for video). Routes by colorspace (grey→BW, colour→COLOR) like PyrVision. engine: 'fast' (saliency) or 'pyrvision' (real YOLO); conf<0 = auto (0.6 BW / 0.8 COLOR); max_frames samples a video.

/analyze.description: Same input as `process` (a camera-trap image or video). Return the detection report as JSON — for an image: colorspace route + per-detection boxes/scores; for a video: per-species summary (frames seen, max conf) and a per-frame timeline. Empty = PyrVision's 'nuls' case.

/export.description: Same input as `process` (a camera-trap image or video). Return a downloadable results bundle (.zip): the annotated image (or montage + annotated clip for video), detections.csv, YOLO-format label files under labels/, report.json, and the species catalog. PyrVision-style export.
